one_liner: Pinterest API v5 is a broad REST API with OAuth 2.0; free, but apps need Pinterest review for Trial access and a video review for Standard access. An official MCP server exists.
auth_notes: Authorization-code OAuth 2.0 with app ID and secret; access tokens last 30 days and refresh tokens are supported. The docs also mention generating an access token, but they present it as an OAuth-derived token.
access_notes: No fee. A business account must request Trial access through the Connect app form, and Pinterest reviews it (about 1-3 business days). Trial content is visible only to its creator and rate limits are tight. Standard access needs a video demo review with no stated timeline.
blocker_notes: Pinterest must approve the app for Trial access before an app ID and secret are issued. Multi-user production use needs Standard access, which requires a video review.
